---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve, or what use case does it enable?

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you would like to see. Be as specific as you can - for
backend changes mention which source file / pipeline stage is affected; for UI
changes describe the interaction and, if possible, sketch the layout.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you explored and why you did not prefer them.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, specs, or prior art that are useful for context.
